mapper.select: SELECT t1.id as id, t1.item_id AS itemId, t1.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, t1.NAME AS NAME, t1.file_path, t1.max_number AS maxNumber, t1.sort AS sort, t1.item_type as itemType, t1.page_config as pageConfig, t1.first_different, t1.odd_and_even_different, t1.page_starting_number, t1.page_number_style FROM bm_batch_record_item as t1 WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t1.record_version_id =#{recordId} order by t1.sort ASC

SELECT t1.item_id AS itemId, t1.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, t1.NAME AS NAME FROM bm_batch_record_item AS t1 WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.item_type = 0 AND t1.record_version_id in
#{item}

SELECT t2.id AS versionId, t1.`name` AS recordName FROM bm_batch_record AS t1 JOIN bm_batch_record_version AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.record_id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.id in
#{item}
